Present Israel–Gaza boundary comparison. The >100 m offset is not, by itself, evidence of a 1949/1950 change. Compare the preserved 1950 patrol-zone coordinates; the largest mismatch is south of the northern adjusted zone. The UN global boundary product independently cross-checks the present OSM Israel–Gaza line to a 372.9 m maximum over the full Israel–Gaza land segment (original-survey independence is unknown). Ship the explicitly labelled present OSM Israel–Gaza land boundary, not an original-1949 reconstruction.
